title: 2 Peter Bible Quiz - Chapter 3
description: Ten questions on 2 Peter 3: the mockers of the last days, the day of the Lord, and new heavens and a new earth.

questions.text: Which letter to them does verse 1 say this is?
questions.explanation: Verse 1 says: this is now, beloved, the second letter that I have written to you.

questions.text: Who does verse 3 say will come in the last days?
questions.explanation: Verse 3 says that in the last days mockers will come, walking after their own lusts.

questions.text: How did the world that existed then perish, according to verses 5 and 6?
questions.explanation: Verses 5 and 6 say the earth was formed out of water and amid water by the word of God, and the world that existed then, being overflowed with water, perished.

answers.text: It was shaken by an earthquake

questions.text: For what have the heavens and the earth that exist now been stored up?
questions.explanation: Verse 7 says the heavens that exist now and the earth have by the same word been stored up for fire, reserved against the day of judgment.

questions.text: One day is with the Lord as what, according to verse 8?
questions.explanation: Verse 8 says that one day is with the Lord as a thousand years, and a thousand years as one day.

questions.text: Why is the Lord patient, according to verse 9?
questions.explanation: Verse 9 says the Lord is patient with us, not wishing that anyone should perish, but that all should come to repentance.

answers.text: He is slow concerning his promise
He waits for the heavens to pass
He wants all to come to repentance

questions.text: How will the day of the Lord come, according to verse 10?
questions.explanation: Verse 10 says the day of the Lord will come as a thief in the night, and the heavens will pass away with a great noise.

answers.text: As a thief in the night

questions.text: What do they look for according to his promise, in verse 13?
questions.explanation: Verse 13 says: according to his promise, we look for new heavens and a new earth, in which righteousness dwells.

answers.text: New heavens and a new earth

questions.text: Who is named in verse 15 as their beloved brother who also wrote to them?
questions.explanation: Verse 15 speaks of our beloved brother Paul, who according to the wisdom given to him also wrote to them.

questions.text: In what does verse 18 tell them to grow?
questions.explanation: Verse 18 says: but grow in the grace and knowledge of our Lord and Savior Jesus Christ.
